text:
Nina Gomez: Quick sync 1: release blog + benchmarks + webinar tomorrow. Target public post at 09:30am PT after the Dedicated canary. Need final changelog URL and an ops green for doc publish window.

Arjun Rao: Changelog will be created when release PR merges. I expect the final URL to be https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.9.1. Ops, can you share canary timing?

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: 2026-04-16T08:50:00Z -> 10% at 08:50Z, 50% at 09:05Z, 100% at 09:20Z. Track: /ops/deploys/17688.

Becca Mills: Marketing prefers publish 09:30am PT so we have a 10min observation window after full rollout. If ops wants a longer buffer, we can push to 09:45am. Also we need the docs snippet fix cherrypicked (quickstart auth header).

Miles Nguyen: I'll handle the cherrypick now. Planning: merge at 08:30am PT and build will publish CDN by ~09:00am PT. Docs landing will be /docs/release/v0.9.1.

Leo H: ML thumb here 1: benchmark numbers approved. Please use exact phrasing: "p95 latency improved 16% under production batching; token cost down ~22% on our typical chat mix." We'll attach the benchmark CSV to the slide deck.

Sam R: Draft announce blurb for social: 
"Meet Redwood Optimize v0.9.1 1: smarter batching and routing that cuts p95 latency ~16% and reduces token costs ~22%. Join our 10am PT webinar for a deep dive + live Q&A. Blog + benchmarks: link in bio."

Nina Gomez: Nice. Ops 1: confirm the canary timeline and whether the pulsed rollout has any blackout windows. Also flag any changes that would require us to delay publish.

Arjun Rao: No blackout. Canary begins 08:50am PT, pause points at 09:05 and 09:20. Ops will pause if error rate or 5xxs spike >0.4% sustained for 3m. If paused, marketing to hold announce.

Miles Nguyen: Cherrypick applied. Docs build kicked off. CDN invalidation ETA 20m.

deploy-bot: Canary stage1 complete (10%). Stage2 50% started at 09:05Z. Monitoring: OK.

Becca Mills: Great. We'll schedule the CMS publish job at 09:15am PT for 09:30am PT live. That gives us time to swap final links in place. Sam, prep social thread and webinar reminder 10m and 1m out.

Leo H: Appendix attached to calendar invite. Slides updated with CSV and note on experiment methodology.

Sam R: CMS draft includes placeholders for changelog/docs that we'll replace once live. Also prepping short FAQ for the blog (cost calc, migration notes, canary behavior).

Nina Gomez: Please drop the final changelog + docs links in this thread when they land and @marketing. Also tag eng-oncall if any post-publish regression shows up.

Arjun Rao: Changelog URL live: https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.9.1. Docs landing live: https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v0.9.1. Marking release PR merged.

deploy-bot: Canary completed to 100% at 09:20Z. No critical alerts during rollout.

Becca Mills: Links received and swapped in CMS. Scheduling active.

Nina Gomez: Publishing now. Webinar reminder queued for 09:50am PT.

Sam R: Social scheduled, threads ready. I'll drop the webinar link 5 minutes before start.

Nina Gomez: Thanks all 1: will file a short post-launch note after the webinar with engagement metrics and any follow-ups. :rocket:
